title: GENERAL INFORMATION
summary: General rules that apply to every AIM sheet: what quantities mean, that attaching parts are shown in design position, where the torque symbol sits, air-tool speeds for prevailing-torque lock nuts and self-drilling (SD) screws, lubrication before sub-assembly, and that belt tension specs are in UPC 6 (Engine). No parts or fastening of a specific component.
notes: Quantity: a shown quantity is the full amount per vehicle for the usage indicated; staple quantity is the number per part; lube, sealer and bulk-item amounts are shown at the point of application when measurable.
Miscellaneous shipping list: loose items shipped with the vehicle are itemized in UPC 0.
Attaching parts: shown in design position; follow it where possible. Bolt/nut assemblies and staples may go in from either direction unless specified.
The torque symbol sits next to the driven part; the mating threaded fastener must not turn while torquing.
Drive prevailing-torque lock nuts with air stall tools slower than 350 R.P.M. to avoid galling or damaging the locking feature.
Fluid-carrying pipes (gasoline, oil, brake fluid, etc.) must be free of inclusions before installation.
Dimensions shown are nominal unless otherwise specified.
Lubricate affected parts (swivels, rods, bushings, bolts, shafts) before sub-assembly, except items with lubrication fittings.
All belt tension specifications are shown in UPC 6 Engine.
Self-drilling screws (SD): drive with air stall tools at 2500-3000 R.P.M. CAUTION: operator pressure should not exceed 30 pounds.
